exposure: preinduction cervical ripening with synthetic hygroscopic dilators (Dilapan-S)
outcome: safety concerns (bleeding, fragmentation, displacement, infections, scar dehiscence)
cohort: Eighty-two women above 18 years with a prior caesarean section at term and a Bishop score of less than 6 were recruited.
finding: The hygroscopic dilator Dilapan effectively ripened the cervix, significantly improving the Bishop score from 2.6 to 5.3, and was found to be safe, though more extensive studies are needed to evaluate scar-related complications during labor.
mod_finding: A 34% vaginal birth rate was achieved (18 spontaneous, 9 instrumental), while 52 women required emergency caesarean section.
